purpose: Routing hierarchy for Report Agent. This file is a navigator, not a competing report template.
rule: For any client analysis or report, read this hierarchy first. It defines which file wins for each report concern.

structure.role: primary source for mandatory four-part report structure: Диагностика, Назначение, Примечание, Приложение

working_template.role: supporting template only; must not override client-readiness gate or prescription template

style.role: live Russian tone and style only; must not override structure or prescription

method.role: Dao, Wu Xing, Bach, homeopathy and consultation logic; must not override report structure or prescription

hard_rules.structure: Any analysis/report uses 4 parts: Диагностика, Назначение, Примечание, Приложение. Source: report-client-readiness-style-gate.md.
hard_rules.prescription: Part 2 must follow report-prescription-template.md exactly. No other file may override this block.
hard_rules.appendix: If appendix exists, every remedy must include a clear supportive послание.
hard_rules.old_templates_are_secondary: Old examples and previous answers may help tone only if they do not conflict with the hierarchy.
